theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Utilities (+1.21%) and Energy (+0.97%) led the market today, while Health Care (-3.49%) and Consumer Discretionary (-2.49%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -1.27%, defensives -1.29%, and value/cyclicals -0.65% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.58%, Dow -1.18%, Nasdaq -0.32% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.52%. The VIX rose 2.75% to 15.72, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.78% to $4,396.70, crude oil was little changed at $94.24, and bitcoin slipped 0.74% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
